title: Early bands heard as a boy: Olympia and Keppard
summary: Desvigne names Freddie Keppard's Olympia band and its clarinetist and violinist, recalling he was too young to know them.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Were there any of the other real early bands that you remember hearing when you were a boy, aside from the Emmanuel Perez group? You mentioned the superior band with the…
The Olympia band, Freddie Keppert. That was Freddie Keppert's band. Yeah, the Olympia, the superior.
Remember who else was with Keppert when you'd hear him? I don't know those guys at all. I didn't know them.

I was quite young, you see. When you were watching the company. Yeah, that's right. I just listened, but I didn't know them. But if I'm not mistaken, one fellow played with him by the name of Piku, if I'm not mistaken. Did he? Played what? Piku played clarinet with that band. And AJ P. And AJ P. Rohn played violin, if I'm not mistaken. Freddie Keppert long years ago.
Yeah. Little San Diego. Yeah, Little San Diego.
Get there. I didn't know much about them then. Did you ever do any teaching?
